item.title: More than 10,800 flights canceled Sunday as massive winter storm sweeps across U.S.
item.description: NASHVILLE (AP) &mdash; A massive winter storm made for a brutal travel day Sunday, with widespread cancellations and delays at some of the nation's busiest airports.Widespread snow, sleet and freezing rain threatened nearly 180 million people &mdash; more than half the U.S. population &mdash; in a path stretching from the southern Rocky Mountains to New England, the National Weather Service said Saturday night. item.title: LDWF agents rescue boaters, stranded drivers in Saturday's winter weather
item.description: OUACHITA PARISH - Agents rescued hunters, boaters, and stranded drivers after they got stuck in winter weather in north Louisiana, the Louisiana Department of Wildlife and Fisheries said.&nbsp;Two duck hunters stuck in shallow water and mud in the Red River were rescued in Bossier Parish. Another pair of boaters was found in Monroe and brought to safety.&nbsp;LDWF said agents found three missing juveniles in a truck that was stuck in Upper Ouachita National Wildlife Refuge.
